- [FACT] The user needs to compress a LiFePo4 battery cell to meet manufacturer specifications.
- [FACT] The dimensions of the LiFePo4 battery cell are 205mm height, 174mm width, and 72mm thick.
- [FACT] The user wants to compress the cell on both sides of its largest face.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The largest face of the LiFePO4 battery cell has dimensions of 205mm (height) x 174mm (width).
- [FACT] The cell needs to experience 300 kgf of fixturing.
- [FACT] The cell will be sandwiched between two steel compression plates.
- [FACT] The steel plates measure 205mm x 174mm.
- [FACT] At each corner of the steel plate, there will be a grade 5 steel 1/4 threaded rod.
- [FACT] The rods run straight through the cell and connect to the opposite steel compression plate on the opposite side.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The force per rod is calculated as 75 kgf.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The force per rod in Newtons is 735.75 N.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The total force applied to the cell is 2943 N.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The area in square meters is 0.03567 m².
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The pressure applied on the cell is approximately 82,469 Pa (Pascals).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The pressure applied to each face of the cell is approximately 41,234.5 Pa.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The compression is being applied to two faces of the cell.
